title: How to Build an Inventory Management System Without Code
summary: Build a custom inventory management system with AI in hours — database, real-time stock tracking, low-stock alerts, and supplier management included. No code needed.
body_markdown: The core system (product catalog, stock tracking, low-stock alerts, multi-user access) takes 2-4 hours. Additional features like barcode scanning or POS integration add a few hours each. Total time for a full-featured system: under a day, compared to weeks for traditional custom development.
